claims.statement: Tom Allen hosted a presentation of colors at his saloon to George Seddons of Boston.
claims.excerpt: presentation of colors last night at Tom. Al-

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: All we want is to give men fair play and no partiality

notes: The saloon's address is not given. Hint claims about Rafferty, a 24-foot ring on 25 Jan, trainer Carey and backer Rooch are not legible in the text and were dropped.
